# Better Money Habits

> A comprehensive personal finance education platform by Bank of America offering guides, tools, and strategies for budgeting, saving, debt management, credit, retirement planning, and financial wellness.

Better Money Habits is Bank of America's free financial education resource designed to help individuals build healthy money management skills across all life stages. The platform combines educational content with interactive tools to support users in achieving their financial goals.

## Key Topics

- Personal Finance
- Budgeting
- Savings Strategies
- Debt Management
- Credit Scores
- Retirement Planning
- Emergency Fund
- Financial Goals
- Money Management
- 401(k) and IRA
- Asset Allocation
- Expense Tracking
- Bank Accounts
- Financial Wellness
- Financial Education

## Core Hubs

- [Personal Finance Education & Tips from Better Money Habits](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en): Homepage for Better Money Habits personal finance education platform
- [Tips for Saving Money & Budgeting Finances](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/saving-budgeting): Hub for savings and budgeting tips, strategies, and debt management
- [Understanding Credit Cards, Credit Management & Credit Scores](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/credit): Hub for credit management, credit scores, and card education
- [Debt Solutions: Tips to Manage and Pay Off Debt](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/debt): Hub for debt management strategies and payoff solutions
- [Tips about Personal Banking and Managing Bank Accounts](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/personal-banking): Hub for personal banking basics, accounts, and financial education
- [Tips on Planning and Saving for Retirement](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/retirement): Hub for retirement planning, 401(k), IRA, and long-term strategies
- [Tips for Planning and How to Pay for College](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/college): College planning hub covering savings, loans, and financial aid

## Savings & Budgeting Guides

- [Your guide to creating a budget plan](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/saving-budgeting/creating-a-budget): Step-by-step guide to creating and managing a personal budget plan
- [Understanding how to manage your savings](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/how-to-manage-your-savings): Guide to savings management strategies for college, retirement, and goals
- [How to Start Building an Emergency Fund & Why You Need One](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/saving-budgeting/emergency-fund-tips): Guide to building and maintaining an emergency savings fund
- [How to Save Money Living Paycheck to Paycheck](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/how-to-stop-living-paycheck-to-paycheck): Strategies for saving money while living paycheck to paycheck
- [How do People Like You Spend Their Money](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/saving-budgeting/spending-tool): Interactive spending analysis tool to compare personal expenses

## Credit & Debt Management

- [How is Credit Score Calculated and What Makes Up a Credit Score?](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/credit/how-credit-score-is-calculated): Explanation of FICO credit score calculation and contributing factors
- [How to get out of credit card debt faster](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/debt/how-to-pay-off-credit-card-debt-fast): Strategies and payment plans for faster credit card debt payoff

## Personal Banking & Accounts

- [What's the Difference Between Checking and Savings Accounts](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/personal-banking/the-difference-between-checking-and-savings-account): Comparison guide explaining checking vs savings account differences
- [What is a Certificate of Deposit (CD) & How Does It Work](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/personal-banking/what-is-a-cd-investment): Educational guide to CDs, terms, interest rates, and FDIC insurance
- [8 Common Bank Fees and Tips for How to Avoid Charges](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/personal-banking/avoid-bank-fees): Guide to common bank fees and strategies to avoid them
- [How to Talk to Your Kids About Their First Debit Card](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/personal-banking/how-to-talk-to-kids-about-first-debit-card): Guide for parents on teaching kids responsible debit card use

## Retirement & Investment Planning

- [Financial Strategy and the Importance of Asset Allocation](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/retirement/asset-allocation): Guide to asset allocation, diversification, and portfolio management

## Optional Resources

- [Sustainable Finance Practices For Everyday - Financial Guide](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/sustainable-finance-practices): Guide to sustainable finance and eco-friendly financial practices
